label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): alert-TP — resolved sink value rememberMeKey = Integer.toString(new java.util.Random().nextInt(99)) at L101-L102; java.util.Random is cryptographically weak and the generated random number directly populates the rememberMeKey cookie/session attribute, enabling predictable authentication bypass. Alert 2 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value includes user-provided cookie value (from getValue()) concatenated into HTML response at L110-L115 without sanitization. Both alerts represent real vulnerabilities.

evidence.note: Insecure randomness source: new java.util.Random().nextInt(99) assigned to rememberMeKey
XSS sink: user-provided cookie value concatenated into HTML response without encoding
